finalText:
All 625 tests pass now (exit code 0).

The bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` was computing tax on the pre-discount `cents` instead of the discounted amount, even though the code comment explicitly said tax should apply after the discount. Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`. That's a one-line change — no other issues found across the other 8 suites.
